ideal: Anyone can read and use the site on any device and with any ability, and finishes a main task in two clicks without waiting.

parts.ideal: The hardest key page reads at grade 9 or lower, and no sentence runs past 30 words
parts.setup: Short sentences and common words; the tab names each page's grade and long sentences

parts.ideal: No axe-core failure on any key page at desktop or phone width
parts.setup: Fix each element by the rule axe names; plain HTML elements before ARIA

parts.ideal: Every target on a phone is at least 24 by 24 CSS px, or spaced to match
parts.setup: Pad small links and icons; space links that sit close together

parts.ideal: Every form field has a label that says what to type
parts.setup: A label element or aria-label on each field; a placeholder alone is no label; list the form pages in params
Fix or redirect a moved page in the change that moves it

parts.ideal: Every main task finishes with Tab and Enter alone
parts.setup: Real links and buttons with visible focus; list the main tasks in params.tasks

parts.ideal: Each main task within two clicks of home, and a first action within 50 words
parts.setup: Link each task from home or the header; put the first link near the top of main

parts.ideal: Taps answered at once: blocking time under 200 ms on a phone, and each form page under 1,600 KiB
parts.setup: Ship less script, split long tasks, keep form pages free of heavy media

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, W3C Recommendation
W3C: Understanding Success Criterion 3.1.5 Reading Level
W3C: Understanding Success Criterion 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
Nielsen Norman Group: The 3-Click Rule for Navigation Is False
Avoid enormous network payloads (Lighthouse total byte weight)

quality: Plain prose a ninth grader reads, no WCAG 2.2 AA failure, labeled fields, tap targets of 24 px and no broken link.
speed: Every main task within two clicks of home, an action within fifty words, and taps answered at once.
consumption: Every form page, where tasks end, under 1,600 KiB to load.
